BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 9, 2026, it acquired a total of 85,200 ordinary shares through various trading venues, with an aggregate volume-weighted average price of $102.8879 per share. These acquisitions are part of CRH's share buyback program, which aims to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. Following these transactions, CRH will have 669,430,097 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,643,874 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.055% of the issued share capital. Disclaimer* 10 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 9 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Aggregate number of ordinary shares acquired Daily volume weighted average price paid Daily highest price paid per share Daily lowest price per share Trading Venue 1,287 $103.2917 $103.91 $102.64 CDED 3,032 $103.0621 $103.85 $102.22 IEXG 2,517 $102.9333 $104.21 $102.25 INCR 731 $102.9843 $104.21 $102.25 WFLP 77,633 $102.8720 $104.98 $102.02 XNYS The redemptions form part of CRH’s intention to buy back ordinary shares of up to $300m in the period to 28 th April 2026 following its announcement on 18 th February 2026 and were effected by CRH’s broker as part of the Program announced on 18 th February 2026. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 669,430,097 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.055% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
